stem: Plantlets show good in-vitro rooting but low survival after transfer. Which interpretation is strongest?
choices: Evaluate acclimatization, root function and environmental transition rather than treating rooting percentage as the final success metric
Only the medium formula can explain the loss
Survival after transfer is unrelated to propagation quality
rationale: Propagation success extends through stable ex-vitro establishment; rooting and acclimatization are connected.
